title: sse-streaming-partial-json-delimiter-ordering-fix
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Fixes SSE partial-JSON delimiter ordering that could cause malformed JSON events during streaming; improves delimiter handling and token/event ordering to ensure partial JSON chunks are reconstructed correctly. No API changes.
body: Context: Several production incidents and internal canaries showed that under high-concurrency streaming loads (SSE) partial JSON events split across TCP chunks could be reassembled with incorrect delimiter/token ordering. This manifested as intermittent JSON parse errors in the OpenAI-compat streaming adapter and rare tool/function-calling events being emitted out of order. Motivation: ensure streaming stability for structured output and function-calling use cases, and reduce customer-facing parse errors.
summary_of_changes: 1) Introduced a deterministic framing reconciler that tracks event delimiters across chunk boundaries and enforces token/event ordering. 2) Fixed delimiter parsing in server/sse/streaming.go to handle cases where '\r\n' separators are split. 3) Added reorder-resilient buffer logic (buffer_reconciler.go) to avoid emitting partial JSON before its delimiters are confirmed. 4) Updated openai_compat/stream_adapter.go to preserve token event order for function/tool-calling streams. 5) Added unit + integration tests and a small fuzz harness for chunk boundary permutations.
commits: c8b1f2a: refactor(sse): add buffer reconciler to track delimiter state
d3ef9b4: fix(sse): correctly handle split CRLF delimiters across chunks
a7f6c21: fix(compat): preserve token event ordering in openai compat adapter
b1d4e5f: test(sse): add fuzz tests and integration scenario for partial JSON
e2c3a9d: docs: document streaming guarantees and migration notes
diff_snippet:
--- a/server/sse/streaming.go
+++ b/server/sse/streaming.go
@@ -120,7 +120,20 @@
-    // previous naive split on "\n\n"
-    parts := bytes.Split(buf, []byte('\n\n'))
+    // handle split CRLF/CR/LF across chunk boundaries; rely on bufferReconciler to
+    // keep partial delimiters until we can confirm full sequence
+    reconciled := r.bufferReconciler.Reconcile(buf)
+    for _, event := range reconciled.Events() {
+        // event is guaranteed to contain a full delimiter and ordered tokens
+        emitEvent(event)
+    }

Aisha Patel: Added fuzz tests and explicit CRLF split case in framing_test.go; addressed in commit b1d4e5f.
Marta Ruiz: Verified that openai_compat changes don't alter non-streaming behavior. Approving after CI passes.
Devon Chen: Left a nit on variable naming in buffer_reconciler.go; addressed in d3ef9b4. Approved.
merge_commit: b4c2f9a - squash: sse streaming: partial JSON delimiter ordering fix
notes_for_ops: No migration required. Rollout: deploy main, monitor e2e-streaming job and streaming-parse-errors metric for 24h. If regression observed, revert by cherry-picking the revert commit created during CI. Backports: prepare cherry-pick to release/1.8 for customers on dedicated instances.
testing_and_validation: Added deterministic unit tests covering delimiter splits, randomized fuzz harness to simulate arbitrary chunk boundaries, and integration tests that run with the OpenAI-compat adapter enabled. CI includes an e2e streaming job that replays captured real-world chunk sequences from incidents.
